scope: Three explicitly reviewed source paths; not complete vendor, package or industrial qualification.

cases.reviewed_scope: Reviewed local current-mode accounting and start-interface compatibility checks; no cross-process device lease is established by this path.
requirements: One canonical robot owner outside per-VM permission groups.
Atomic admission must include every affected joint/mode; rejected mode combinations must produce no partial command.

cases.reviewed_scope: Reviewed active-control lifetime and command dispatch; the local mutex and object reset do not constitute authenticated physical-stop evidence.
requirements: Independent control ownership, command cardinality/units and controller mode checks.
Unexpected exit leaves effect state unknown; receiver replacement needs stop and effect reconciliation.

cases.reviewed_scope: Reviewed fixed low-command publisher, periodic controller and motor commands. A topic publish can enable motors and write gains/targets; CRC is not an authority grant.
requirements: Motor-enable, mode, gains, position, velocity and torque need explicit semantic policy even when carried by DDS.
Publisher/topic authority alone must not grant every possible physical effect.
Keep control-loop timing in the stable-authority contract; explicit attenuation may invalidate stability guarantees.
